DROP TABLE [BNKM].[CustomerLocation]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[CustomerLocation]
( 
	[CustomerId]           [bigint]      NOT NULL,
	[LocationTypeId]       [int]      NOT NULL,
	[LocationId]           [int]      NOT NULL,
	[PeriodStartTimestamp] [datetime]      NOT NULL,
	[PeriodEndTimestamp]   [datetime]      NULL,
	[GlobalLocationNumber] [bigint]      NULL,
	[PreferenceId]         [int]      NULL,
	[CustomerLocationNote] [nvarchar](256)      NULL,
	[HoldMailIndicator]    [char](1)      NULL,
	[HoldMailInitiatedById] [int]      NULL,
	[HoldMailReason]       [varchar](200)      NULL,
	[SourceCode]           [varchar](20)      NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [int]      NOT NULL,
	[WorkFlowId]           [bigint]      NULL,
	[TaskRunId]            [bigint]      NULL,
	[InsertDttm]           [datetime]      NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO
